expectations.text: Output includes a triage assessment section answering the 6 mental model questions
expectations.evidence: No triage assessment section. Goes directly to Summary then Architecture & Design.

expectations.text: Review comments use conventional comment labels
expectations.evidence: Uses 'Medium Severity'/'Low Severity' labels instead of conventional comments format
Has 'Verdict: Approve with minor suggestions' at end

expectations.text: Review discusses API graduation lifecycle, feature gate implications, or backward compatibility
expectations.evidence: Discusses v1alpha1/v1beta1 types, deprecation, conversion layer absence, backward compatibility

expectations.text: Review considers impact on other teams or API consumers
expectations.evidence: No explicit cross-team impact analysis. Mentions no SIGs or consumer impact.

expectations.text: Output follows the defined structure with sections
expectations.evidence: Uses different structure: Summary, Architecture & Design, Issues & Concerns, Test Coverage, Verdict
